title: Synthetic Materials
seo_title: Grade 7 Synthetic Materials Worksheets: Plastics, Nylon and Natural Resources
standard_text: Gather and make sense of information to describe that synthetic materials come from natural resources and impact society.
meta_desc: Free middle school science worksheets on synthetic materials (NGSS MS-PS1-3): natural vs. synthetic materials, plastics and fibers made from oil, how materials are made, and their impacts on society. 100 practice questions with answers.
key_big: Synthetic materials are made from natural resources.
key_sub: Chemical reactions turn oil, minerals and air into plastics, fabrics, medicines and fertilizers that affect our lives and the environment.
body_html:
How to think about it

Synthetic materials are made by people. Chemists use chemical reactions to change natural resources into new substances with useful properties.

  • Plastics, nylon, polyester and synthetic rubber come from petroleum (oil).
  • Fertilizer is made from nitrogen in the air and natural gas.
  • Some medicines, like aspirin, are based on chemicals first found in plants.

Synthetic materials help society (cheap packaging, strong fabrics, medicines) but can also cause problems (plastic pollution, factory waste).

Example

Is nylon natural or synthetic?

It is made from oil by chemical reactions.

Answer: synthetic

Example

What natural resource is used to make plastic bottles?

Plastic polymers are made from oil.

Answer: petroleum (oil)

Common mistakes

  • Thinking synthetic materials do not come from natural resources.
  • Thinking synthetic materials are always harmful; many help people.
  • Calling cotton or wool synthetic.

faq.a: A material made by people using chemical reactions to change natural resources, like plastic made from oil.

faq.q: Do synthetic materials come from nature?
faq.a: Yes. They all start as natural resources such as petroleum, minerals, plants or air.

faq.q: How do synthetic materials affect society?
faq.a: They give us useful products like medicines and strong fabrics, but they can also cause pollution and waste.
